_comment: Our own concise directions for each Tablet Shard, keyed by shard number.
The facts (which area, which chapter, what landmark) are extracted from the
sources listed in sources.py; the wording here is original, written for this
project, because the guides' own directions are their authors' editorial
writing and are not ours to reproduce. Each shipped record keeps a sourceUrl
so a reader can go and read the original write-up.
Numbering follows PowerPyx. Other guides number shards differently, so match
by area rather than by number when comparing against another guide.
1: Commercial District, left of the weapon and item stalls, among crates. Take the east path from the area's main entrance.
2: South-west of the village, on the left-hand side of the pool.
3: Cross the wooden bridge east on entering; right of the stone wall ahead.
4: Cross the wooden bridge west, then turn left at the torch for a hidden path. Follow it up the ladder; behind the wall on the left.
5: Second area: down the entry steps, behind the two grey-green cylinders.
6: After shard 5 the bridge collapses. Win the fight, climb the ladder and the next stairs; behind the fallen stone pillar just below.
7: South of the Item Shop, along the wooden pier, behind barrels on the right.
8: Just west of the Weapon & Armour shop, at the foot of the tree.
9: Behind the stalagmite at the far end of the cave.
10: Past the fountain at the entrance, up the stairs on the right, at the ledge's edge.
11: Top of the first main area: after the staircases, before the room, at the end of the right-hand ledge.
12: Next room, up the stairs, left at the end of the visible ledge.
13: First side area on the left after entering, by an NPC and a gated arch with electric lights; in the corner.
14: Second intersection of the main area (noticeboard west, shops east), behind a pile of wooden crates.
15: Shipyard: up the first stairs, then up the stairs left of the main platform; at the path's end beside the ladder.
16: Shipyard: up the first stairs, then down the stairs right of the main platform; by the third metal girder.
17: On the harder route (decline Lid's 1,000 Gil offer), in plain sight round the corner past the yellowish tree from the Elven Maven sub quest. Teleport from the Save Point to the entrance to switch routes.
18: On the easier route (pay Lid 1,000 Gil at the entrance), up the long ladder, in plain sight beside a tree. Teleport from the Save Point to the entrance to switch routes.
19: After leaving the dungeon, from the World Map head south past the Shrine of Zidane and re-enter by the upper entrance (the Ramuh Esper route). Down the small stone ramp, hidden behind rocks.
20: South-west corner of the main area: cross the wooden bridge, head south, at the path's end.
21: North-west of the main area, down the steps to the Mom Bomb arena, then south along the path.
23: Up the first lift, east through the fence gap into the generator room holding the second lift's switch. South-east corner, down the ladder, then west.
24: After the second lift, north through the area; behind the shipping container just before the next fenced lift.
25: First room: rather than taking the elevator ringed by four green crystals, look behind the right-hand pillar.
26: Further along the story path, at an elevator atop a staircase; in the gap between the staircase and its right-hand railing.
27: From shard 26 head south, take the next crystal elevator across, then look on the platform's left side.
28: Just right of the central platform on entering, beside the NPC offering boat tours.
29: City centre, due north of shard 28: a pool with two stone statues; by the bench behind the left statue.
30: From the statue pool head north-east past the giant water wheel; midway along the stone bridge, behind the plant pot.
31: From the statue pool (shard 29) head north up the steps; behind the tree.
32: On the story path, after the boat maze, at the dock on the far side of the room; immediately left, unmissable.
33: After the long boat maze, through the door, in front of the waterfall; the room with the Save Point and ladder.
34: Returning later in the story, a hidden path opens in the room left of the entrance. Up two ladders along the narrow path.
35: Second room of the dungeon (the room after the Save Point when revisiting): up the stairs, east, beside the ladder.
36: In the room of stone platforms beneath the large waterfall, on one of the platforms.
37: Same room: north over the wooden bridges, on a rock between the waterfalls.
38: South of the Weapon and Item Shops, by the well on the small grassy island.
39: North of the Item Shop, before the long bridge, beside the tree on the right.
40: In the room with the circular central platform and four cross-shaped paths, down the north stairs once the water level is lowered.
41: Further on, in the boat among the water-level crystals: sail north-east past the balcony with the friendly Viridian Pot; on a ledge to the right.
42: After lowering the water further and descending the long ladder, just to its left.
44: Beside the station's eastern staircase entrance; you arrive next to it entering from the south on the World Map.
45: Castle Plaza, directly east of the tram stop.
47: Slums, just east of the arrival point, beside barrels.
48: Underground Tunnel (story): east to the metal walkway, down the stairs, then back west down the small ramp and south; in the room's corner.
49: Underground Tunnel, further in: south past the Pot enemy's room to a metal bridge. A hidden entrance beneath it leads up to a room on the right.
50: North-west corner: Jake's room, marked by two rebel flags. Walk behind its right side for a hidden path to the crates, up the ladder, then a few paces south-west.
51: North-east area: facing the exit to the rebel conference room, up the stairs on the right, behind the metal pillar by the railing.
52: Lava-floor main area: west, up the stairs and across the platforms to a crystal switch. Press it, cross the raised girder, turn left.
53: Lava-floor main area: up the long ladder by the Save Point to the platform of three crystal switches. Turn the left switch three times. From the ladder top, straight north then second left.
54: With the Master Key, head south to the second block of cells; first cell on the right.
55: With the Master Key, return to the room you were imprisoned in; a now-unlockable cell on the west side.
56: Behind the left-hand horse statue of the two flanking the throne room stairs.
57: Up the throne room stairs, right-hand hallway, first door; south-east corner.
58: Colosseum, far west of the initial path. The Colosseum opens in Chapter 4, via the west exit from Grandshelt's main screen.
59: From the main entrance, down the stairs on the right by the teleport crystal; tucked in the corner behind an NPC.
60: Storefront district (walk or teleport), directly south of the Weapon Shop beside two crates.
61: From shard 60 head west past the Item Shop into the blue teleporter; in the circular fountain area, by the second pillar on the right.
62: Entrance room, reached by the blue portal: south-west, among the writing desks.
63: Two steps up from the village entrance, between a bench and a pot.
64: Far north-east of the village, beside the snowman outside an igloo.
65: First room, as far west as possible, beside a fallen pillar.
66: Second area, south of the Save Point down the stairs, by the fallen chandelier.
67: Final room with the second Save Point: up the ladder east, then around the balcony to the far west. Only reachable after completing Nameless Ruins.
68: Left of the large padlocked gate, under a chain.
69: West of the gate, in the westernmost tent (where Sol stands during the story); among crates in the top-right corner.
70: Far end of the third area west of the gate, in a clearing, after the cutscene unlocking the gate's first padlock.
71: Top of the main entrance, up the stairs behind the large crystal.
72: Further up the spiral staircase, on one of the landings.
73: Higher still on the spiral staircase, on a landing before the Azure Pot enemy.
74: Higher again, on a snowdrift on the story path past the Azure Pot enemy.
75: Across the bridge into the next area, north to the small army camp; behind supplies in the bottom-right corner.
76: Right-hand side of the house at the town's north-western end.
77: Level 1 security card route (west of the main entrance room), in the room with desks and the green teleporter.
78: Level 1 security card route, in the room with three consoles to switch on; atop the shelves in the south-east corner.
79: Level 2 security card route (east of the main entrance room), in the room of green teleporters. Through them, up the long ladder, on the gantry to the right.
80: Just west of the first Save Point, beneath a dead tree.
81: East of the second Save Point and down the ramp, in the corner.
82: North of town, just east of the Weapon and Item Shop entrance, concealed behind the waterfall.
83: Leaving the first room, at the south end of the landing before either staircase.
84: Down the west stairs, south to the end, then east; on a staircase blocked by a fallen pillar.
85: From shard 84, follow the story path down the long ladder, west, up the parallel ladder, then south; against another broken pillar.
86: From the second Save Point, north through the door into the long room (tombstone: "The mighty wield blades, the clever command magic"). Behind the stairs on the north side, east into the hidden room under the torch, up the stairs, then up the Violet Pot enemy's ladder.
87: From the third Save Point, up the ladder to the crystal elevator room; collect it after the third elevator, before taking the fourth.
88: East past the item shop, under a blossom tree.
89: From the first Save Point, follow the story path to the ramp crossroads and take the downward path.
90: Further along the story path, beside two pine trees on the platform between the two wooden bridges.
91: West side of the lake, under a tree.
92: North of the first Save Point, on the bend of the story path.
93: South-west of the second Save Point, at the dead end.
94: On the story path, after taking the left turn at the first fork past the Save Point.
95: Further along the story path, among stones right beside you after a cutscene.
96: From the entrance, follow the main path and take the first fork right.
97: From shard 96, left at the next fork, then the next right.
98: In the area where translucent bridges appear as you approach: from the third solid platform go north, then west along the bridge.
99: Near the dungeon's end, at the Rogue Magitek Armour fight (the enemy shown on the map).
